fields.name: question
fields.note: The geopolitical or macroeconomic forecast question to answer (e.g. 'Will the Fed cut rates before July?', 'Will GDP growth exceed 2% this year?').

fields.name: resolution_criteria
fields.note: Optional. The observable event or data release that resolves the question.

fields.name: context
fields.note: Optional. Additional context: current indicators, policy guidance, market pricing, recent events.

fields.name: deadline
fields.note: Optional. Resolution date or time horizon.
